{{Top}}
[[File:KaminoanSaberdart-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Mk I Saberdart]], or referred to as a [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] saberdart]]
A '''poison dart''' was a dart that was either coated in [[Poison/Legends|poison]] or injected poison upon impact. Poison darts were also known as '''toxic darts'''.

Poison darts were preferable over more direct [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] means for several reasons. First, with an appropriate toxin, the victim's [[Death/Legends|death]] could be nearly-instantaneous, and essentially guaranteed. Secondly, the use of lethal toxins often incapacitated the target before they even realized what was happening, protecting the identity of the attacker and allowing time for escape. Because of these reasons, these exotic weapons were used by various [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and criminals across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], most notably [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Jodo Kast]]. The only drawback is that they had a relatively short range.

[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used a [[Dathomirian poison dart/Legends|Dathomirian poison dart]] during a mission to get revenge on her former [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. She planned to use the dart, which was circular with retractable wings and a retractable [[Needle (disambiguation)|needle]], to numb his senses so her [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] allies [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] and [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] could help to kill him. However, Dooku was proven to be too strong despite the poison.

After escaping the jungles of [[Tenupe]], [[Alema Rar]] created some poison darts from the poison of a [[wasber]], which she used, in conjunction with a [[Blowgun/Legends|blowgun]], when she attempted to kill [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The dart was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force pushed]] away from Solo by [[Lumiya]], and was injected into the [[World Brain]], killing it. Rar would later use her poison darts to attempt to kill [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] on [[Roqoo Depot]], and the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', but failed both times as well. Weeks later, a poison dart ultimately spelled Jade Skywalker's doom when Solo, whom she was attempting to kill for his allegiance with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], stabbed one into her leg. The dart was similar in design to those used by Rar, so the [[New Jedi Order]] incorrectly deduced that she was responsible for Jade Skywalker's death. Rar was thus hunted down and killed, while Solo managed to avoid discovery until he was exposed by [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Lon Shevu]].

==Behind the scenes==
These weapons are carried by the protagonist [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] throughout the ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' game. They are extremely scarce, as he can only carry up to 15 at a time and are hard to resupply. Only extremely large creatures, [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and 'bosses' are immune to the darts.
